description: Compose, edit, preview and render videos with captions, graphics and audio through CueFrame’s hosted MCP server.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http cueframe https://api.cueframe.ai/v1/mcp

notes: A CueFrame account is required; metered media operations consume account credits.
Headless automation can use an API key as documented by the publisher.
Metadata matches the publisher-maintained public setup documentation. Public Apache-2.0 license covers plugin/toolkit, not hosted server implementation.
